summary: Choir oohs: soft voices, gospel, trap, ambient, cinematic
label: choir oohs
body: Long chords; trap uses a dark choir under the bells. Bigger: GeneralUser GS/Concert Choir.

Register: MIDI 48-79 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Voice Oohs, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Voice Oohs") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
